info.title: Kling 4.0 Text-to-Video Task - Submit Task
info.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 text-to-video task via `/kling/text-to-video`. Query task status with `GET /kling/tasks`. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); the related parameters are not supported yet.

post.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 text-to-video task via `/kling/text-to-video`; the model is specified by `model_name`. Query task status with `GET /kling/tasks`. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); the related parameters are not supported yet.

value.prompt: A man in a white shirt walks along the beach at dusk, camera slowly following, realistic cinematic style.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (width:height) of the generated video.

duration.description:
Target video duration in seconds; supports integers from 3 to 30.
- When set, this value takes precedence over any duration in the prompt
- When omitted, the explicit duration recognized from the prompt is used
- When omitted and no explicit duration is found in the prompt, defaults to 10 seconds

The final target duration is used for billing and is available as `usage.output_duration` in the task query response.

callback_url.description: Callback URL for task results. When configured, the server notifies you whenever the task status changes.

external_task_id.description:
Custom task ID.
- It does not override the system-generated task ID, but can be used to query the task
- Must be unique per user

watermark_info.description: Whether to also generate a watermarked result. Configured with `enabled`; custom watermarks are not supported.

enabled.description: `true` generates a watermarked result, `false` does not.

prompt.description:
Text prompt, which may contain both positive and negative descriptions.
- Up to 26,000 characters for pure English, 11,000 characters for pure non-English
- Mixed input must satisfy: English characters/26000 + non-English characters/11000 ≤ 1
- Describe the visual content, actions, camera movement, and event order
- To use images, videos, or elements as references, use the omni reference endpoint

code.description: Error code; see the error code documentation.

request_id.description: Request ID generated by the system for tracking and troubleshooting.

status.description: Task status: submitted, processing, succeeded, or failed.

create_time.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

update_time.description: Task update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: Custom task ID of this task, if any.
